source_criterion_issues_model_reported: Retrieval path: the live ClinicalTrials.gov study page is JavaScript-rendered and a direct fetch returned only the page shell; the ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 endpoint was refused (robots disallowed). The eligibility text above comes from the web search engine's indexed copy of https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07156539. That index date is unknown and may lag the live record. It was not verified against the live rendered page.

Exclusion criteria are incomplete. Item '6.' appears in the retrieved source with no text, and further items beyond 6 may exist. The ctv.veeva.com mirror lists six numbered exclusion items, all with blank text, which suggests six items in total, but this is unconfirmed. Because of this, no overall eligibility statement is made.
Inconsistent indexed renderings of the same ClinicalTrials.gov URL: a second snippet showed exclusion '1.' with empty text and item 2 only. The fuller snippet (items 1–5 with text) was used.
The decentrialz.com mirror lists exclusion items corresponding to source items 1, 2, 3 and 5 and omits item 4 (endocrine disorder). It was treated as corroborating only, not authoritative.

Indexed record metadata: brief title 'A Phase 3 Study of HS-20094 in Patients With T2DM'; condition 'Type 2 Diabetes'; status NOT_YET_RECRUITING; sponsor Jiangsu Hansoh Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.; comparator dulaglutide QW. The Veeva mirror reports 546 estimated participants and protocol ID HS-20094-303.

A type 2 diabetes diagnosis is implied by the title and conditions but is not an enumerated inclusion criterion in the retrieved text, so no separate criterion was created. The patient record contains a generic SNOMED 44054006 'Diabetes' (onset 2017-12-11, raw status active) and a later concurrently active 'Prediabetes' (onset 2018-12-17). Diabetes type cannot be determined from this, and T2D is not inferred from metformin prescriptions.
Inclusion items 3 (HbA1c) and 4 (BMI) state no explicit time window in the retrieved text; screening-time measurement is presumably intended but not stated.

Inclusion item 2 is internally ambiguous: 'maximum tolerated (≥1000mg daily)' and the two alternative regimens (metformin alone, or metformin plus one SGLT-2 inhibitor) both carry a ≥90-day stability requirement relative to an undefined screening date.

The patient record's latest dated facts are 2020-12-28. reference_date 2021-11-30 is used only as a hypothetical screening anchor for exclusion 5's relative 4-week window (2021-11-02 to 2021-11-30). No consent, screening or randomization date exists in the data. This is a synthetic Synthea patient, and no current-eligibility claim is made.

criteria.criterion_text: Males and females, Age ≥18 years at the time of signing informed consent.
criteria.reasoning: Gender recorded as male, and the criterion admits both sexes. Birth date is 1977-12-05, so the patient is ≥18 on any date from 1995-12-05 onward; age_years_at_reference is 43 at 2021-11-30. No consent date exists, but any plausible consent date after the record period would also satisfy ≥18.

criteria.criterion_text: Stable daily dose(s) for ≥90 days prior to screening of : 1) Any metformin formulations ≥1500 mg daily or maximum tolerated (≥1000mg daily). 2) Any metformin formulations ≥1500 mg daily or maximum tolerated (≥1000mg daily) with one type of SGLT-2 inhibitors;
criteria.reasoning: The record has five orders for '24 HR Metformin hydrochloride 500 MG Extended Release Oral Tablet' (RxNorm 860975), authored 2017-12-11 (x2), 2018-12-17 and 2019-12-23 (raw status 'stopped'), and 2020-12-28 (raw status 'active'). Every dosage_instruction is empty, so the daily dose (number of 500 mg tablets per day) is unknown. The ≥1500 mg or maximum-tolerated ≥1000 mg threshold therefore cannot be evaluated. Prescriptions are not proof of administration or adherence, and there are no dispense, administration or statement records. No SGLT-2 inhibitor appears in the record. Stability for ≥90 days before an undefined screening date cannot be established.
criteria.missing_information: ["Prescribed daily metformin dose (tablets/day or mg/day)", "Evidence of actual use/adherence (dispense, administration or statement records)", "Dose stability over ≥90 days before screening", "Screening date", "Whether any SGLT-2 inhibitor is used", "Whether a lower dose reflects maximum tolerated dose"]

criteria.reasoning: Recorded HbA1c (LOINC 4548-4) values are 7.56% (2017-12-11), 6.06% (2018-12-17), 5.47% (2019-12-23) and 5.62% (2020-12-28). Only the 2017 value falls within 7.5–11.0%. The most recent value (5.62%) is below the range, which points against meeting the criterion. However, the retrieved text gives no measurement window, the intended value is presumably at screening, and no screening-time HbA1c exists. Marked UNKNOWN rather than NOT_MET for that reason.
criteria.missing_information: ["HbA1c measured at the trial's screening visit", "Explicit timing requirement for the HbA1c measurement"]

criteria.reasoning: All recorded BMI values are ≥23 kg/m2: 29.18 (2012-02-20), 30.22 (2015-02-23, 2017-12-11, 2018-12-17), 27.89 (2019-12-23) and 28.49 (2020-12-28, the most recent). This consistently supports the threshold. However, the intended measurement is presumably at screening and no screening-time BMI exists, so it is not marked MET.
criteria.missing_information: ["BMI measured at the trial's screening visit", "Explicit timing requirement for BMI"]

criteria.criterion_text: Uncontrollable hypertension(with or without antihypertensive treatment) : systolic blood pressure ≥160 mmHg or diastolic blood pressure ≥100 mmHg at screening.
criteria.reasoning: Recorded BP (systolic/diastolic, mm[Hg]) values are 117/78 (2012-02-20), 124/88 (2015-02-23), 114/78 (2017-12-11), 120/76 (2018-12-17), 136/83 (2019-12-23) and 117/80 (2020-12-28). All are below the 160/100 thresholds, and no hypertension diagnosis is recorded. The criterion specifies BP 'at screening', and no screening-time measurement exists. Historical readings do not affirmatively establish absence at screening.
criteria.missing_information: ["Blood pressure measured at the trial's screening visit", "Antihypertensive treatment status"]

criteria.criterion_text: Diagnosed or suspected with type 1 diabetes mellitus, special types of diabetes or secondary diabetes.
criteria.reasoning: The record contains SNOMED 44054006 'Diabetes' (onset 2017-12-11, raw clinical status active, verification confirmed), which does not specify type. Also present: 'Prediabetes' (onset 2018-12-17, active), 'Hyperglycemia (disorder)' and 'Metabolic syndrome X (disorder)' (both onset 2018-12-17, active). No type 1, special-type or secondary diabetes code is recorded, but missing records are not negatives. The generic diabetes code leaves the type undetermined, so absence cannot be affirmed.
criteria.missing_information: ["Diabetes type classification", "Investigator assessment of suspected type 1, special-type or secondary diabetes", "Clarification of the concurrently active 'Diabetes' and 'Prediabetes' entries"]

criteria.criterion_text: History of significant hematological disorders (e.g., sickle cell disease, hemolytic anemia, myelodysplastic syndrome, etc.) or other conditions causing hemolysis or instability of red blood cells (e.g., malaria, hypersplenism, etc.).
criteria.reasoning: No hematological disorder or hemolysis-related condition appears among the recorded conditions. Hemoglobin was 15.465 g/dL (2012-02-20) and 15.485 g/dL (2017-12-11), but isolated CBC values do not establish absence of the listed disorders. A missing diagnosis record is not affirmative evidence of absence.
criteria.missing_information: ["Documented hematological history or explicit negative history", "Current hematology assessment"]

criteria.criterion_text: Presence of an endocrine disorder or history that may significantly affect bady weight(e.g., Cushing's syndrome, hypothyroidism or hyperthyroidism, except hypothyroidism if thyroid hormone replacement dose has been stable for at least 6 months) ;
criteria.reasoning: No Cushing's syndrome, thyroid disorder or other weight-affecting endocrine diagnosis is recorded. There are no thyroid function tests and no thyroid hormone prescriptions. The recorded obesity finding and metabolic syndrome are not examples listed by the criterion. Absence of records is not affirmative evidence of absence.
criteria.missing_information: ["Endocrine history or explicit negative history", "Thyroid function tests", "Thyroid hormone replacement status and dose stability, if applicable"]

criteria.criterion_text: Severe infection, severe trauma, or moderate-to-major surgery within 4 weeks before screening.
criteria.reasoning: With reference_date 2021-11-30 as a hypothetical screening anchor, the window is 2021-11-02 to 2021-11-30. The record's latest dated facts are from 2020-12-28, so there is no data covering the window. The only recorded infection, 'Viral sinusitis (disorder)' (2019-02-22 to 2019-03-12, resolved), is outside the window. No surgical procedures or trauma are recorded, but the lack of data in the window does not establish absence.
criteria.missing_information: ["Clinical records covering the 4 weeks before screening", "Actual screening date"]
